caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the owner (onlyOwner)

pending_tx_observable.meaning: a pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() call is observable in the mempool by an MEV bot
pending_tx_observable.checkpoint: before the pending transaction is mined

caller_provided_deadline.meaning: the liquidity-increase transaction carries a caller-provided deadline parameter (rather than a hardcoded block.timestamp)
caller_provided_deadline.checkpoint: at construction of the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() transaction

execution_time_exceeds_deadline.meaning: the transaction is executed at a block.timestamp after the caller-provided deadline, i.e. the deadline has expired
execution_time_exceeds_deadline.checkpoint: at execution of the held transaction

transaction_executes_after_hold.meaning: the held transaction still executes even though it was held past the caller-provided deadline
transaction_executes_after_hold.checkpoint: at execution of the held transaction

assumptions: The owner is the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange(); the MEV bot observes but does not itself hold owner authority.
The deadline expiry requirement applies to every liquidity-increase transaction, not only the concrete incident.
execution_time_exceeds_deadline is evaluated against the caller-provided deadline carried by the transaction, not against a fixed hold duration.

unresolved.description: Report gives the intent example deadline as block.timestamp + 5 minutes but does not state a concrete caller-provided deadline value for the actual transaction; the deadline is therefore represented symbolically as a caller-provided parameter.
Report does not state whether the owner is the MEV bot or a separate victim; onlyOwner restricts the caller, so the attacker's relationship to the owner is ambiguous.

limitations: The impact's listed hold durations (1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month) are illustrative; the relation uses the caller-provided deadline expiry condition rather than a fixed hold-duration bound.
Stale pricing parameters and arbitrage value extraction are separate impacts not formalized by this plan.
No concrete observed transaction or extracted amount is given; the hold/execution is described as a possible attack vector.
